When medical cryofreeze becomes a viable option to prevent death until a remedy for what's killing you can be found, will you allow that option to be used on you? What about for interstellar travel?
I totally would, living longer seems nice, living on another planet seems even nicer.

It's cliche but it kind of relates to immortality in a way. Let's say I get cancer. I opt in for cryogenic preservation. Time passes. More time passes. Finally they discover a cure. I'm revived and my cancer is totally gone and I'm given a squeaky clean bill of health. But now everyone I ever knew is either long dead or close to it. Family, friends, my wife, my dog. Everything is gone.

I'd rather have died back then than have to reconcile all these deaths and changes that happened while I was frozen.

Interstellar travel would be cool though. As long as I had some idea of where I'd end up.
If I'm going to die then I'm leaving behind life as I know it anyway. I may as well have a second life after that in some cool science fiction future.
